# Lead Hub Workspace
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: route the request to the smallest matching stage, or invoke `workflows/matic/CONTEXT.md` for an issue labeled `matic`.

Technical delivery workspace for the private, self-hosted Lead Hub web application. It follows the Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM) through scoped stage contracts and plain-text handoffs. The existing Define, Design, Build, Measure, and Learn stages remain the application build pipeline. The matic workflow wraps that pipeline for GitHub issue delivery.

## Task Routing

| Task | Go To | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Run the next issue labeled `matic` | `workflows/matic/CONTEXT.md` | Rank eligible open issues, plan the simplest one, execute the build pipeline, and prepare a PR |
| Resume a matic run | `workflows/matic/CONTEXT.md` and the recorded `run-state.md` | Continue from the recorded stage without restarting unaffected work |
| Check a matic PR or close a merged issue | `workflows/matic/CONTEXT.md` | Verify review or merge state and close only the related issue after merge |
| Define a delivery request or new cycle | `stages/01-define/CONTEXT.md` | Establish outcome, boundary, inputs, and missing decisions |
| Verify environment or design the solution | `stages/02-design/CONTEXT.md` | Confirm capabilities and produce a stack-aware design |
| Build or change application source | `stages/03-build/CONTEXT.md` | Implement the smallest approved change and prepare evidence |
| Test or audit a build | `stages/04-measure/CONTEXT.md` | Check acceptance, security, quality, and evidence |
| Decide the next cycle | `stages/05-learn/CONTEXT.md` | Convert findings into actions, decisions, or blockers |
| Show pipeline status | Scan `stages/*/` | Report which stage artifacts exist |

## Cycle

```text
Define -> Design -> Build -> Measure -> Learn
             ^                 |
             |_________________|
```

The Learn stage may route work back to Define, Design, or Build. Measure and Learn are always the final two stages of a cycle.

For a matic issue, the orchestration stages before and after this cycle are:

```text
Select -> Plan and update PM Control -> Define -> Design -> Build -> Reconcile
-> Measure -> Learn -> Publish -> Verify merge -> Close issue
```

`Publish` and `Close issue` are lifecycle operations, not replacements for the Build, Measure, or Learn stages.

## Run Rules

For a normal cycle, use `application/runs/` as `{{OUTPUT_ROOT}}`. For a matic issue, use `application/runs/<date>-matic-issue-<number>-<slug>/` as `{{RUN_PATH}}`. Show the path before creating it, never overwrite a prior run, and resume from its recorded `run-state.md` when requested.

Stage contracts define the minimal context to load. References are stable rules. Run outputs are working artifacts. Application source remains outside run folders as the canonical implementation.
